{{Short description|British materials scientist}}
'''Lawrence Michael Brown''' [[Fellow of the Royal Society|FRS]] [[HonFRMS]] (born 18 March 1936) is a British material scientist.
He is emeritus fellow at [[Robinson College, Cambridge]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.admin.cam.ac.uk/reporter/2001-02/special/03/22.html|title = Reporter Copyright © 2001 the Chancellor, Masters and Scholars of the University of Cambridge.//: ROBINSON COLLEGE}}</ref>

In 2017 he was made an [[Honorary Fellow of the Royal Microscopical Society]] (HonFRMS) for his contributions to microscopy.<ref name="RMS1">{{cite web|title=Honorary Fellows|url=http://www.rms.org.uk/membership/honorary-fellows.html|website=www.rms.org.uk|accessdate=18 December 2017}}</ref>

==Life==
He was [[W. M. Tapp Fellow]] at [[Gonville and Caius College, Cambridge]].
